title: Analytics carry no customer data and use the existing user identity
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. On the Work Orders QA build with Google Analytics enabled for the org and a way to observe the events fired (browser devtools Network tab, or engineering/dev support).
  4. Ensure the location has eligible lead technicians and work orders so the displays and fields can be exercised.
  5. Analytics observation available.
custom_steps:
1. Trigger the display, exposure, and change events.
  2. Inspect the event parameters.
  3. Confirm only predefined field keys and setting values are present — no names, identifiers, search text, or dollar amounts.
  4. Confirm the existing analytics identity is reused and no new customer identifier is added.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Analytics may contain predefined field keys and setting values only — never displayed record values, names, identifiers, search text, or dollar amounts.
  • Analytics reuses the existing analytics identity and adds no new customer identifier.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-TBD (Story 12 has no Jira story yet) — Story 12 Google Analytics for display and field usage. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S12-R5, S12-R15 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R5: “Analytics may contain predefined field keys and setting values, but no displayed record values, names, identifiers, search text, or dollar amounts.”
  • S12-R15: “Reuse existing analytics identity without introducing another customer identifier.”
